decisions.briefing: Stocks rallied broadly today: the NASDAQ rose 2.6% and the S&P 500 rose 2.4%, a clear risk-on signal. Our strategy says to put spare cash to work on days like this, so we're using the remaining $446 to start a position in LGN, the highest-scoring candidate that isn't overbought. All 7 existing positions stay as they are and will be handled by their automatic profit targets and stop-losses.

market_education.summary_en: US stocks rose sharply across the board, with the NASDAQ up 2.6% and the S&P 500 up 2.4%, a classic risk-on session in which investors move money into growth and higher-risk names. Gains were led by semiconductors, AI infrastructure and communications hardware (MPWR, AMD, TTMI and SMTC all show bullish momentum), while megacap NVDA lagged and is still below its 20-day average. No specific news headlines were included in today's data, so this explanation relies only on price and momentum signals, not on reported catalysts.
market_education.summary_zh: 美股今日全面急升，納斯達克指數漲2.6%，標普500指數升2.4%，屬典型的「風險偏好」行情，資金明顯流向增長股及較高風險資產。半導體、AI基建及通訊硬件板塊領漲，MPWR、AMD、TTMI及SMTC等個股動能強勁；反觀龍頭NVDA表現落後，股價仍低於20日均線。由於今日數據未附具體新聞標題，以上分析僅根據價格及動能指標，並非基於已報導的催化因素。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: A risk-on day is when investors feel confident and move money into riskier assets like growth and tech stocks, which pushes the major indexes up together. Strong broad gains like today's 2%+ moves are often a good time to put idle cash to work, because momentum is more likely to carry on in the short term. Even so, it pays to avoid stocks that are already overbought (RSI above 70), since they can pull back quickly.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「風險偏好」（Risk-On）指投資者信心充足，主動把資金投向增長股、科技股等較高風險的資產，帶動各大指數同步上揚。像今日指數升逾2%的普漲行情，往往是動用閒置現金入市的好時機，因為短期動能較有機會延續。不過，仍應避開RSI高於70、已處於超買區的股票，以免追高後遇上急速回調。
